description: Find domain names and the extensions that fit a business. Returns, by mode, name ideas with prices, extensions that fit with reasons, one name across extensions, availability for a list of domains, prices per extension, or the extension catalog. Use to name a business or check domains before buying one; it never registers or buys a domain. For facts about a domain that is already live use site-intel. mode decides which fields apply: company_name and description for the suggest modes, query for search-extensions, domains for check-availability, tlds for pricing. Cost: suggest-names 5 credits, suggest-extensions 3 credits, search-extensions 2 credits, check-availability 1 credit, pricing 1 credit, tlds 1 credit, charged only when a call succeeds.

company_id.description: Optional O-mega/Founden company id; pulls the real business brief to ground the fit.

company_name.description: The business name (suggest-extensions), or for suggest-names a natural-language brief: any ordering or limit it states (for example "shortest" or "renewal under $15") is read and applied beneath your explicit search_options.

description.description: What the business does; grounds the fit (suggest-* modes).

exact_extension.description: search-extensions: check ONLY the typed extension.

offset.description: search-extensions: pagination offset into the catalog.

purpose.description: What the domain is for (suggest-names / suggest-extensions): website (the site address), cold (a dedicated cold-email domain, kept apart from the site) or extra. Context the model weighs when judging fit; it sets no search options, which are yours to choose (search_options) from what the company needs.

query.description: An exact name to check across extensions (search-extensions).

search_options.description: Search options, only the fields you set (suggest-names / search-extensions / suggest-extensions): priorities (objective keys in priority order: total_length, annual_price, renewal_price, registration_total, semantic_fit, brandability, label_length), max_total_length and max_label_length (characters), max_annual_price, max_renewal_price and max_registration_total (USD), hacks (include, exclude or only) and allow_premium (boolean). A field you set wins over what the company_name brief asks for; null (or priorities: []) leaves that field to the brief; unknown keys are rejected. Options that do not apply to a mode are ignored there. The response echoes the effective options (search-extensions: search_options; suggest-names: search_plan.search_options).

tlds.description: Extensions to price (pricing), to check the name across (search-extensions), or to restrict name ideas to (suggest-names).
